Name: HOTEL — Sophia Palace Vámház körút 2
Notes: Fővám tér, District V. M4 at the door, Great Market Hall across the street, Liberty Bridge 100 m.

Name: FLAT — Mandlgasse 18 1120 Wien
Notes: Meidling. U6 Niederhofstraße 250 m. Meidlinger Markt around the corner. Free weekend street parking.

Name: BREAKFAST — Great Market Hall
Notes: Mon 6-17, Tue-Fri 6-18, Sat 6-15, closed Sun. CLOSED Aug 20, open normally Aug 21. Bakery counters + lángos + coffee. MOSTLY CASH. ~6,000-9,000 HUF for three.

Name: BREAKFAST — Fakanál Étterem (market gallery)
Notes: Hot Hungarian breakfast, only air-conditioned spot in the hall. Eggs 2,100 Ft, coffee 1,200 Ft. ~9,900 Ft for three.

Name: BREAKFAST — Cafe Brunch Budapest Fővám tér 2-3
Notes: 30 seconds from the hotel. All-day breakfast daily, terrace on Liberty Bridge. ~12,000-16,000 HUF for three.

Name: BREAKFAST — Kelet Kávézó Bartók Béla út 29
Notes: The local option, 10 min over Liberty Bridge. Mains 2,000-4,000 HUF. Opens 07:30 weekdays, 09:00 weekends — check Aug 21.

Name: BREAKFAST — Ignaz & Rosalia Meidlinger Markt 37
Notes: Vienna answer both mornings. Sat 8-18, SUN 9-18 when all shops are shut. Order the Marktfrühstück. ~€35-50 for three.

Name: DINNER — Meidlinger Alm
Notes: Austrian hut food — Kasnocken, goulash. Mon-Sat 8-23, Sun 10-18. 200 m from the flat.

Name: MARKET — Meidlinger Markt (stalls)
Notes: Stalls Mon-Fri 6-21, Sat 6-18, CLOSED SUNDAY. Cafés stay open Sunday 10-18.

Name: Etele P2 / Őrmező P+R (M4 Kelenföld) — MAIN CAR PARK
Notes: FIRST CHOICE: M4 direct to Fővám tér in 12 min, and Saturday's M1 drive starts here. Surface, guarded, 0-24. ~6,300 HUF for 40 h. CASHLESS. Reach it via the M0 southern ring.

Name: Örs vezér tere P+R (M2) — BACKUP
Notes: Easiest off the M3 but one change: M2 to Keleti, M4 to Fővám tér, ~25 min. Best base for Thursday's fireworks.

Name: Pillangó utca P+R (M2) — second backup
Notes: Same tariff, one stop closer in. Use if Örs is full.

Name: KÖKI Terminál P+R (M3) — AVOID height limit
Notes: Three-level garage in a mall. Not for a 1.9 m car.

Name: VIENNA — free street parking by Mandlgasse
Notes: Free Sat-Sun citywide. NOT Meidlinger Hauptstraße/Niederhofstraße/Pohlgasse/Rauchgasse/Tivoligasse/Reschgasse before 12:00 Sat. Never in resident-only bays. Move before 09:00 Monday.

Name: Vienna fallback — Bahnhof Wien Meidling garage
Notes: 630 m from the flat if the street fails.

Name: Vienna P+R Erdberg (U3) — last resort
Notes: €4.60/24h, open decks. Wrong side of town from the flat.

Name: THU 1 — Liberty Bridge (Pest head)
Notes: 300 m / 4 min from the hotel door. Cross on foot to Buda then turn RIGHT (north) onto the lower quay. Do NOT head north on the Pest side — that was the old wrong route.

Name: THU 2 — Buda lower quay (car-free promenade)
Notes: Closed to cars Aug 15-22 so it is a riverside promenade on your dates. 900 m / 11 min north to Döbrentei tér. Gellért Hill above, Pest skyline opposite.

Name: THU 3 — Döbrentei tér
Notes: On the quay. 315 m / 4 min more to Várkert Bazár. Also part of the food-street area (Döbrentei utca).

Name: THU 4 — Várkert Bazár terraced gardens
Notes: 1.9 km / 23 min cumulative from the hotel. Free to walk, holiday programming. Friday 14:15 comes back down through here.

Name: THU 5 — DINNER Magyar Ízek Utcája / Street of Hungarian Flavours — CORRECTED LOCATION
Notes: TAKE-OUT, eat standing up. THE REAL 2026 SITE IS HERE ON THE BUDA SIDE: Várkert Bazár + Várkert rakpart + Clark Ádám tér + Lánchíd u. + Ybl Miklós tér + Döbrentei u. + Apród u. OPEN 09:00-24:00, Aug 20-22. It is NOT by Parliament / St Stephen Square — that old pin was 2.9 km the wrong way. Country Bread 2026 = Pilisi Pityókás (Hel Pékség). Beer capped under 1,000 HUF, water max 500 HUF.

Name: THU 6 — Clark Ádám tér (under the Chain Bridge)
Notes: Keep going north on the same car-free quay. 660 m / 8 min from the food street.

Name: THU 7 — FIREWORKS SPOT Bem rakpart (BEST)
Notes: PREFERRED. The car-free quay itself, square on the Parliament façade. 1.7 km / 22 min from the food street, all on the Buda bank, no river crossing. Show 21:00, ~30 min total, fireworks cut to 10 min this year, light painting 22:30-01:00. Agree a physical meeting point — networks fail.

Name: THU 7b — FIREWORKS ALT Batthyány tér (M2)
Notes: Same view and it has a metro station. 370 m south of Bem rakpart. Use if you want the M2 at your feet afterwards.

Name: THU 8 — WALK HOME over Elisabeth Bridge (alternative to the metro)
Notes: Batthyány tér to the hotel on foot = 3.1 km / 40 min back down the car-free quay. Beats a crushed M2-M3-M4 with two changes (~20 min). Metros run to ~02:30.

Name: Kossuth tér open-air disco (free)
Notes: DJ sets to 01:30. Light art on Parliament until 01:00.

Name: PARLIAMENT — Kossuth tér queue
Notes: FREE open day 10:00-16:00. Nothing to book. Dome Hall + Holy Crown. Airport-style security, no big bags.

Name: MOVED FROM THU — Szabadság tér
Notes: WAS Thursday 17:30, which was wrong: 2.3 km / 29 min from the hotel in the opposite direction to the fireworks. Now 640 m / 8 min from the Parliament queue you are already standing in. Optional 15 min. Then 700 m / 9 min to the Shoes.

Name: MOVED FROM THU — St Stephen Basilica (+ dome terrace)
Notes: WAS Thursday 17:00, which was wrong: 1.8 km / 23 min from the hotel, opposite direction to the food street and the fireworks. Now heat-block option C, and the dome terrace is the best central viewpoint in Pest. NOTE: the Holy Right Procession leaves here at 19:00 on Thu (not 18:00) — incompatible with a 19:15 riverside fireworks spot.

Name: Shoes on the Danube Bank
Notes: Small, quiet, the most affecting thing in the city.

Name: Széchenyi István tér
Notes: Gresham Palace and the Academy.

Name: Chain Bridge on foot
Notes: Pedestrianised during the festivities — rare.

Name: Funicular — Clark Ádám tér
Notes: The ride is part of the fun. Or bus 16 free on a pass.

Name: Fisherman's Bastion
Notes: The postcard view. Lower terraces free.

Name: Matthias Church + Trinity Square
Notes: Tiled roof is the thing. Square free.

Name: Buda Castle terraces
Notes: Free to walk. Holiday programming today.

Name: Vienna Gate (Bécsi kapu tér)
Notes: Quiet north end of Castle Hill.

Name: Várkert Bazár gardens
Notes: Terraced gardens down to Elisabeth Bridge.

Name: LUNCH — Great Market Hall (own front door)
Notes: Gallery stalls for goulash and stuffed cabbage; downstairs for paprika and salami to take home.

Name: Lunch backup — Karaván street food
Notes: TAKE-OUT. Next to Szimpla on Kazinczy. Open late.

Name: HEAT BLOCK A — Dohány Street Synagogue
Notes: Largest in Europe, with museum and memorial garden.

Name: HEAT BLOCK B — House of Terror
Notes: Andrássy út 60. Heavy and excellent.

Name: Hungarian State Opera
Notes: Start of the Andrássy út walk.

Name: Oktogon → M1 Millennium line
Notes: Oldest metro on the continent after London. UNESCO. The train is the attraction.

Name: Heroes' Square
Notes: Millennium Monument.

Name: Vajdahunyad Castle + City Park
Notes: Fake castle on a lake. Shaded, free.

Name: SUNSET — Gellért Hill Citadella
Notes: Full panorama, sunset ~19:50. Hot climb, take water.

Name: LUNCH — Naschmarkt + flea market
Notes: Stalls to graze plus sit-down places. Saturday is flea market day. Dead on Sundays.

Name: Karlsplatz
Notes: Karlskirche and the Secession.

Name: Staatsoper
Notes: Then up Kärntner Straße.

Name: Stephansdom
Notes: Nave free; towers ticketed.

Name: Hofburg
Notes: Imperial palace complex.

Name: Albertina (optional)
Notes: Monet to Picasso plus the state rooms.

Name: Vienna Classic Days — vintage cars on the Ring
Notes: Free parade, starts 18:00 where you already are.

Name: Rathausplatz Film Festival
Notes: FREE. Stalls 11:00-midnight. 20:30 Imagine Dragons on a 300 m² screen. Runs in rain.

Name: Schönbrunn Palace
Notes: 2 U4 stops from the flat. Thin crowds before 10:00. Interior needs a booked slot.

Name: Gloriette
Notes: Free walk up. Best view back over Vienna.

Name: FREE Jazz Brunch — Rathausplatz
Notes: 12:00-14:00. All shops in Austria shut on Sunday, so this is lunch too.

Name: RAIN BLOCK A — Kunsthistorisches Museum
Notes: Open Sundays, closed Mondays. Allow 2-3 h.

Name: RAIN BLOCK B — Belvedere
Notes: Klimt's The Kiss. Upper Belvedere.

Name: Café Central
Notes: The grand one. Short queue likely.

Name: Café Sperl
Notes: Older, shabbier, more genuine. 1880s fittings.

Name: Demel
Notes: Imperial confectioner.

Name: DINNER A — Heuriger in Grinzing
Notes: Tram 38 from Schottentor. Wine among the vineyards.

Name: EVENING B — Faust at Rathausplatz (free)
Notes: Vienna State Opera on the big screen. Free.

Name: NEUSTIFTER KIRTAG — Aug 20-23 wine festival
Notes: THE PICK. 650 m of road closed, Heuriger tables in the street, UNESCO-listed rituals, 100,000 visitors. FREE to walk in. SUNDAY is the free/last day 12:00-22:00: brass band from 12:00, Die Wuppa 17:00-21:00, no reservations. U6 to Nussdorfer Straße then bus 35A. DON'T DRIVE.

Name: STUMM & LAUT — Aug 20-22 silent films + live electronica
Notes: FREE. Helmut-Zilk-Park, Hlawkagasse 2, 1100. SAT AUG 22 IS CLOSING NIGHT. Two S-Bahn stops from Bahnhof Wien Meidling — closest evening to the flat. volxkino.at/stumm-und-laut

Name: AFRIKA TAGE — Aug 14-24 Donauinsel
Notes: PAID: ~€12.20-12.90 advance, €10 before 16:00 / €20 after 17:00 at the door. Mon-Sat from 14:00, Sun from 11:00, to midnight. Concerts 18:00, headliners 20:00. U6 to Handelskai + 400 m walk.

Name: Kino am Dach — rooftop cinema until Sept 12
Notes: Ticketed rooftop screenings on the main library, Urban-Loritz-Platz 1070. Direct U6 to Burggasse-Stadthalle, in the bar district.

Name: Frameout — MuseumsQuartier free open-air cinema
Notes: Free documentaries and art films in the MQ courtyard until Aug 29. Next to the Kunsthistorisches Museum.

Name: Ellátó Kert — best all-rounder
Notes: Klauzál tér 2. Shaded garden, locals, resident prices.

Name: Füge Udvar
Notes: Dob u. 19. Szimpla's look at half the price. Opens 16:00.

Name: Fogasház / Instant-Fogas
Notes: Akácfa u. 49-51. Underground electronic. All night.

Name: Élesztőház
Notes: District IX. 20-30 Hungarian craft taps, cask-ale corner.

Name: Szimpla Kert
Notes: Kazinczy u. 14. The original — one drink, before 21:00.

Name: Csendes
Notes: Near Astoria. Quiet, surreal, good for talking.

Name: Kőleves Kert
Notes: Kazinczy u. 37-41. Big summer garden.

Name: Anker't
Notes: Paulay Ede u. 33. Big courtyard garden.

Name: Jazzcafe Sofa
Notes: Lindengasse 3. Beer €2.80, spritzer €2.40. Mon-Sat 17:00-02:00.

Name: 7Stern Bräu — DINNER option
Notes: Siebensternstraße 19. Brewpub, shaded garden, hearty food. Best group dinner in the bar district.

Name: Bukowski The Pub
Notes: Siebensterngasse 8. Daily 16:00-06:00.

Name: Kreisky
Notes: 7th district dive, till 04:00. Verify exact address in the app.

Name: Café Anno
Notes: Lerchenfelder Straße. Cheap draught, foosball. Verify address in the app.

Name: Weinstube Josefstadt
Notes: Piaristengasse 27. Ivy garden, Grüner Veltliner, cold cuts and strudel.

Name: Bitzinger Würstelstand — late-night TAKE-OUT
Notes: By the Albertina. Käsekrainer + beer at 2 a.m.

Name: Palatinus Strand — BEST bath in August
Notes: Margaret Island lido: outdoor pools, slides, wave pool, shade. 4,400-7,000 HUF.

Name: Lukács Bath — value pick
Notes: 8,000 HUF. Shaded, cool pools, no queue, locals.

Name: Széchenyi Bath
Notes: ~14,800 HUF weekend rate. Use the outdoor pools and 18 °C plunge.

Name: Rudas Bath
Notes: 15,000 HUF Fri-Sun. Rooftop pool over the Danube.

Name: Margaret Island — musical fountain
Notes: Closest shade and grass to the centre.

Name: SMALL TRIP — Cogwheel Railway start
Notes: Up into the Buda Hills. Cooler and shaded.

Name: SMALL TRIP — Children's Railway (Széchenyi-hegy)
Notes: Run by 10-14-year-olds since 1948.

Name: SMALL TRIP — Elizabeth Lookout Tower
Notes: Highest point in Budapest, 360° view. Chairlift down.

Name: SMALL TRIP — Memento Park
Notes: Communist statues in one field. Bus from Kelenföld.

Name: SMALL TRIP — Aquincum Museum
Notes: Roman city under Óbuda. Quiet, unvisited.

Name: VIENNA TRIP — Kahlenberg viewpoint
Notes: Bus 38A from Heiligenstadt. View over the city and Danube.

Name: VIENNA TRIP — Klosterneuburg Abbey
Notes: 20 min by S-Bahn. Monastery with its own winery.

Name: VIENNA TRIP — Donauinsel
Notes: U1 Donauinsel. 21 km of free river beaches and bars.

Name: VIENNA TRIP — Prater / Riesenrad
Notes: Old funfair. Ferris wheel is the one paid thing worth it.

Name: START - Rivne, 05:00 on Thu Aug 20
Notes: Tank full at Ukrnafta or BRSM. 770 km to Budapest, ~10 h driving, but you gain an hour crossing into UTC+2 so you arrive 15:00-15:30. The early start also gets you over the Carpathians in daylight.

Name: Lviv - breakfast + driver change
Notes: 213 km, bang on halfway, last easy place to eat properly. Rynok Square. Put the freshest driver on the mountains that follow.

Name: Stryi - the slow part starts here
Notes: 282 km. 136 km of Carpathian passes to Svalyava: two lanes, loaded trucks, nowhere safe to overtake. Give it 2 hours.

Name: Svalyava - out of the mountains
Notes: 418 km. M06 roadworks across Zakarpattia this summer - single-lane light-controlled sections, allow 20-30 min.

Name: Mukachevo - last cheap fuel
Notes: 440 km from Rivne. Change drivers, top up, 30 km to the crossing. On the way home this is the bail-out point if anyone is too tired - last easy accommodation before the passes.

Name: Palanok Castle - OPTIONAL only if ahead
Notes: 150 UAH. 14th-century fortress on a volcanic cone, right by the road. Costs 45-60 min and pushes Budapest to 16:15-16:30 - fine for the fireworks but it eats the afternoon.

Name: CROSS HERE - Luzhanka / Beregsurany
Notes: ~30 km SW of Mukachevo. Same 330 km to Budapest as Chop but avoids the section being dug up. Clocks go back an hour here. Pin approximate.

Name: Vasarosnameny - the M3 starts here
Notes: HAVE THE D1 10-DAY E-VIGNETTE (6900 HUF) LIVE BEFORE THIS POINT - ematrica.nemzetiutdij.hu. Then 3 h of motorway to Budapest.

Name: ALTERNATIVE crossing - Chop / Zahony
Notes: Bigger crossing, also straight onto the M3, same 330 km - but 40 km of poor road to reach it.

Name: HOME RUN - Hegyeshalom
Notes: Leave Vienna 06:00, here in 45 min. M1 to the M0 southern ring, round Budapest, onto the M3. ~1000 km to Rivne, about 16 h with three drivers rotating.

Name: FILL UP on the way home - Mosonmagyarovar / Gyor
Notes: Hungary averages 1.58 EUR petrol / 1.81 diesel vs Austria 1.72 / 1.97. Leave Vienna on what is in the tank and fill here. Exit into town, not a motorway service area.
